name: nr_pucch_family
description: 独立 Python 单 RB PUCCH 0..4 基本调制、资源、DM-RS 与无噪声解调子集；不覆盖完整频跳、码本和 UCI 编码。
implementation: Standalone NumPy implementation; explicit limited coverage in tool_registry.json.

params.description: JSON 对象字符串。nrPUCCH: format_number,uci_bits 或 ack,sr,nid,initial_cs,nrb,num_symbols；格式 0: ack,sr,nid,initial_cs,num_symbols；格式 1: uci_bits,nid,initial_cs,num_symbols；格式 2..4: 已编码 uci_bits,nid,nrb,num_symbols；Decode: symbols,format_number,nid,initial_cs,num_symbols,noise_variance；格式 0 解码另可设 ack_bits,allow_sr；Indices/DMRSIndices: nrb,rb,symbol_start,num_symbols,format_number,index_base；DMRS: nid,nrb,num_symbols,format_number,initial_cs；HoppingInfo: nid,slot,initial_cs。

function.description: 调用的 MATLAB 入口名

result.description: 该入口的结构化计算结果

example.result: 按入口参数返回 JSON 对象；缺失必需参数时返回 error
